crew.overview: Pakistan-born comedian Kumail Nanjiani and grad student Emily Gardner fall in love but struggle as their cultures clash. When Emily contracts a mysterious illness, Kumail finds himself forced to face her feisty parents, his family's expectations, and his true feelings.
crew.title: The Big Sick

details.biography: Lauren J. Brown works as a production designer, art director, set decorator, property master, and scenic painter for stage and screen productions. She holds a BA in Technical and Production Arts from the Royal Scottish Academy of Music and Drama, Glasgow, Scotland, and was a Special Research Fellow in Design at the Yale School of Drama, New Haven, Connecticut.
details.name: Lauren J. Brown
